name: Lotus
scene: A blooming pink lotus flower floats on rippling water at golden dawn.
notes: Layered lotus petals use rose and gold; flowing dawn and water bands use teal and jade. Portrait 3:4 design sheet, white exterior, closed black oval rim. Target 92–132 panes; exact traced count is not verified. Visually reviewed and regenerated once to remove the gold background sun and restore the background colour pair. Remaining doubts: subtle fill variation, crowded tapered contacts near the upper central petals and flower base, and occasional same-colour neighbouring petals may require merging during tracing. This is a design sheet, not audited puzzle geometry.
